en.hubeali:
And by this chain, from Salih Bin Uqba, from Yazeed Bin Abdul Malik, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When (Rasool-Allah) was Blessed with (Syeda) Fatima<sup>asws</sup>, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Revealed to an Angel, so he spoke with in the tongue (tone) of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>: ‘So name her<sup>asws</sup> as ‘فَاطِمَةَ’ Fatima<sup>asws</sup>’. Then said: ‘I<sup>azwj</sup> have Liberated the knowledge for you<sup>asws</sup> and Freed you<sup>asws</sup> from any impurity’.
Then Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And Allah<sup>azwj</sup> had Liberated the knowledge for her<sup>asws</sup> and Freed you<sup>asws</sup> from any impurity’.
en.sarwar: 6. Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated from Salih ibn ‘Aqaba from Yazid ibn ‘Abd al-Malik from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.
“When Fatima (a.s.) was born Allah sent an angel to make the tongue of Muhammad (s.a) call her ‘Fatima’. Then he said, “I set you free (from ignorance) with knowledge and set you free from menses.”
Abu Ja‘far (a.s.) then said, “By Allah, He had set her free with knowledge (from ignorance) and from menses at the time universal covenant (al-Mithaq).”
